site.name: Lhan dhondeam khatir AI helper
hub.lead: Tumcho chodd vell khata tem kam venchat. Dor helper tumchea phone-acher, tumi adinch vaprotat tea AI-ant, tumchea bhaxen kam korta.
lang.label: Bhas
step.answer.note: Khuinchoch prosn goroz na. Khalli dovrat vo "pass" (sod) type korat. Tumchea keyboard-acho mic dabun uloupak xoktat.
keepout.title: He kednanch type korum nakat
keepout.body: Giraykanchim nanvam vo phone number, ID number (Aadhaar, PAN, passport), bank, UPI vo card mahiti, password vo OTP, bholaikechi mahiti.
helper.what: Hio AI khatir sucheo. Tumi sogleo vachunk goroz na.
copy.fail: Hanga copy zalem na. Text dabun dhorat, magir Copy venchat.
use.title: To koso vaprunk
use.2: Claude, vo tumi adinch vaprotat to AI ugddat, ani novo chat suru korat.
use.4: Magir giraykacho message paste korat vo aichem kam sangat, nanvam vo number ghalinastanam.
save.title: Fuddlea pavtt khatir dovrat
save.body: Helper WhatsApp-ant svotak dhaddat ("Message yourself", svotak message), mhonnje khuinchea-i disa to porot copy korunk zata.
save.project: Paid Claude plan asa zalear, ek Project korat ani helper tachi sucheo mhunn paste korat. Magir tea Project-antlo dor chat tumcho dhondo adinch zannta.
try.title: Hanga try korat
try.note: Hem tumchea svotachea Claude account-acher choltta. Hem page kaim save korina.
laptop.title: Laptop-acher? Puro version install korat
laptop.body: Puro version-ant chodd pavlam, dakhle ani surokxeche nem asat. Sokoil aslolo dor Skill download korat. Magir Claude-ant Settings (setting), magir Capabilities (xokti), magir Skills (kosob) ugddat, ani file upload korat. Tumkam code execution (code cholovp) chalu aslolo paid plan zai (October 2026 meren).
laptop.code: Claude Code vo Cowork-ant hi collection ek pavtt add korat, magir ho helper install korat:
draft.note: Ho anvad (translation) draft asa. Upkar korun hi bhas borem vachta tea konnakuch dakhoun check korat.
footer: Fukot vaprunk ani bodlunk (CC0). Hem draft korta; tumi sogllem svota check korun dhaddtat.
err.declined: Hanga try korunk, hea page-ak Claude vaprunk porvangi diyat. Vo helper copy korun Claude-ant vaprat.
err.busy: Ekach pavtt chodd try zale. Ek minut ravat, magir porot try korat.
err.generic: Tem zalem na. Tache bodlak helper copy korun Claude-ant vaprat.
empty.answers: Tumi sogllem khalli dovorlam. Toxem cholta: helper tumkam vichartolo.
pkg.start-here.title: Hanga suru korat
pkg.start-here.short: Ozun khatri na? Hea soptakant AI mozot korunk xokta oslem ek kam sodat.
pkg.start-here.problem: Tumcho soptak khub bhorla, punn poilem khuinchem kam AI-ak diunk tem tumkam khatri na.
pkg.start-here.outcome: Ek spoxtt kam, poilem kitem try korchem, ani uprant khuincho helper ugddcho.
pkg.start-here.q.business.hint: Udaharonn: Mandrem-ant homestay, café, cleaning service.
pkg.start-here.q.week: Tumchea soptakantlo khuincho bhag sogllean chodd vell khata?
pkg.start-here.q.week.hint: Udaharonn: giraykank zap, post, booking, kamgar, kagdpotram.
pkg.start-here.try.label: Taka tumchea soptakavixim sangat
pkg.start-here.try.placeholder: Hanv ek lhan café chalovtam. Sokallim WhatsApp order-antuch vetat ani post korunk maka kednanch vell mellona.
pkg.customer-replies.title: Giraykanchea message-ank zap
pkg.customer-replies.short: AI sodanchea zapanche draft tumchea xelint korta; tumi te check korun dhaddtat. Tumchi goroz asa tioch zapo tumi boroitat.
pkg.customer-replies.problem: Disak dozanamni WhatsApp message. Chodduxe tech prosn vichartat, ani dor ekak zap divunk ghante vetat.
pkg.customer-replies.outcome: Tumchea xelint sodanchea zapanche draft, tumchi khori goroz asa tea message-anchi lhan list, ani don tap-ant dhaddunk zata osle quick replies (beginche zap).
pkg.customer-replies.q.business: Tumcho dhondo khuinchea prokaracho, ani khoim?
pkg.customer-replies.q.facts: Girayk sogllean chodd kitem vichartat, ani tumche zap kitem?
pkg.customer-replies.q.facts.hint: Vell, sevo, tumi khuinchea vattarant vetat, mol koso thorta, booking koxem korchem. Mol ghatlear cholta. Giraykanchim nanvam vo number naka.
pkg.customer-replies.q.tone.hint: Udaharonn: mogall ani lhan, thodem Hinglish, sodanch dev borem korum mhonnop.
pkg.customer-replies.q.needs_me: Khuinche message sodanch tumchea kodench yeunk zai?
pkg.customer-replies.q.needs_me.hint: Udaharonn: tokrari, discount, site visit, vhodd order.
pkg.customer-replies.try.label: Giraykanche ek-don message paste korat
pkg.customer-replies.try.placeholder: Customer 1: hi 2bhk deep cleaning-acho rate kitlo, ani aitarak tumi free asat?
pkg.booking-reminders.title: Booking ani ugddas
pkg.booking-reminders.short: Confirm ani ugddasache message, je giraykank nemkem kitem korchem tem sangtat.
pkg.booking-reminders.problem: Girayk booking kortat, magir kitem gheun yevchem tem visorttat vo yenant. Dor ekak hatan confirm korop ani ugddas korop vell khata.
pkg.booking-reminders.outcome: Booking message-ancho puro set (confirm, ugddas, vell bodol, girayk ailo na, dev borem korum). Puro version-ant ek booking sheet ani ek dispottachi routine-ui mellta.
pkg.booking-reminders.q.business: Lok tumchea kodem kitem book kortat?
pkg.booking-reminders.q.business.hint: Udaharonn: udkachi test, deep cleaning visit, yoga class.
pkg.booking-reminders.q.where: Girayk tumchea kodem yetat, vo tumi tanchea kodem vetat?
pkg.booking-reminders.q.where.hint: Ani khoim: tumcho address chat-a bhair dovrat; fokot "amchi lab" vo "tanchem ghor" mhonnat.
pkg.booking-reminders.q.prep: Giraykan adim kitem korunk vo gheun yeunk zai?
pkg.booking-reminders.q.prep.hint: Fokot tumcheo svotacheo sucheo. Udaharonn: ek nitoll bottle, kitlem, kitlea vorar meren.
pkg.booking-reminders.q.timing.hint: Udaharonn: adlea disa sanje ani 2 vor adim.
pkg.booking-reminders.try.label: Ek booking sangat
pkg.booking-reminders.try.placeholder: udkachi test booking, Birestar, October 22, 10 am, amchea lab-ant.
pkg.follow-ups.title: Zap haddtat osle follow-up
pkg.follow-ups.short: Ek bhodr 3-pavlancho follow-up, dispottachi "aiz konnak message korchem" list, ani dis sompota tednam ek report.
pkg.follow-ups.problem: Tumi soglleank sompork kortat, punn dor call vo zap naslolea message-acho follow-up korunk vell na.
pkg.follow-ups.outcome: Ek tayar follow-up sequence, aiz konnacho follow-up asa tem dakhoita asli tracker, ani tumchea notes-antlean ek lhan dispottacho report.
pkg.follow-ups.q.who.hint: Udaharonn: adle supporter, member, quote maglolo girayk.
pkg.follow-ups.q.ask.hint: Udaharonn: amchea December drive-ant bhag ghevat, membership novi korat, ek visit book korat.
pkg.follow-ups.q.sign: Tumchea message-anchea xekak tumi koxi sohi kortat?
pkg.follow-ups.q.sign.hint: Udaharonn: tumchem poilem nanv ani group-achem nanv.
pkg.follow-ups.try.label: Tumchi sequence magat
pkg.find-clients.title: Nove client sodat
pkg.find-clients.short: Tumche sogllean bore girayk polloun, konnak sodchem, khoim ani kitem sangchem tachem spoxtt chitr korat.
pkg.find-clients.problem: Tumkam novea client-anchi thir list zai, punn konnak sodchem vo koso sompork korcho tem tumkam khatri na.
pkg.find-clients.outcome: Giraykanche prokar, tumi svota vaprunk xoktat osle search shobd, tumchem nanv sucheunk xoktat osle thoille partner, ani tumchea xelint poile message.
pkg.find-clients.q.offer.hint: Udaharonn: café ani homestay khatir social media management.
pkg.find-clients.q.best: Tumche 3 sogllean bore girayk sangat (prokar, nanvam nhoi)
pkg.find-clients.q.best.hint: Udaharonn: 20 kuddanchem resort, novo café, ek yoga school.
pkg.find-clients.q.area.hint: Udaharonn: North Goa, sogllo Goa, online sogllea India-bhor.
pkg.find-clients.q.channel.hint: Email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram vo mukhamukh.
pkg.find-clients.try.label: Pavl 1-an suru korat
pkg.get-found-on-google.title: Google-acher dison yeyat
pkg.get-found-on-google.short: Puro Google profile, sarke shobd, ani khore review mellovpachim pavlam.
pkg.get-found-on-google.problem: Tumi viktat tem lok tumchea vattarant sodtat tednam, tumcho dhondo dison yena.
pkg.get-found-on-google.outcome: Tumchea Google Business Profile khatir checklist, Google-achea mer-bhitor ek vornnon ani sevanchi list, soptakache post, review magpacho message ani search shobdanchi list.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.business.hint: Udaharonn: builder ani event khatir equipment bhaddean divop.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.services: Tumcheo mukhel sevo vo vostu (chodd korun 5)
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.towns: Tumi khuinchea xarank vo vattarank seva ditat?
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.towns.hint: Udaharonn: Mapusa, Panjim, Margao, sogllo North Goa.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.status.hint: Hoi ani verify zala, hoi punn verify zaunk na, na, vo khatri na.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.different: Tumkam vegllem kitem korta? (fokot tumi dakhoun divunk xoktat tem)
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.different.hint: Udaharonn: tech disa delivery, operator sangata, dhondeant 15 vorsam.
pkg.get-found-on-google.try.label: Bhag 1-an suru korat
pkg.staff-checklists.title: Kamgaranchi checklist
pkg.staff-checklists.short: Dor role khatir ugtem korpachi, bond korpachi ani dispottachi spoxtt checklist, zantum tumi nastanai kam choltolem.
pkg.staff-checklists.problem: Dor monis kam vegllea toren korta, ani tumi nastanam gozali chuktat.
pkg.staff-checklists.outcome: Dor role ani shift-ak ek checklist, vonticher dovrunk ek lhan version, ani soptakachi 15 mintanchi check (puro version).
pkg.staff-checklists.q.business.hint: Udaharonn: bakery ani bar aslolo café.
pkg.staff-checklists.q.roles.hint: Udaharonn: kitchen, bakery, bar, cash counter.
pkg.staff-checklists.q.slips.hint: Udaharonn: fridge check kelo na, counter sarko bond kelo na, stock boroilo na.
pkg.staff-checklists.try.label: Ek role ani ek shift sangat
pkg.hire-and-onboard.title: Kamgar ghevop ani tancho svagot
pkg.hire-and-onboard.short: Sarke lok haddtat osle job post, modench soddpi unne, ani ek xant poilo soptak.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.problem: Tumkam kuxol lok zai, punn te sompork kortanant, vo sign-up korta korta modench soddtat.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.outcome: Lok khoim soddtat ani poilem kitem sudharchem, job post ani sompork message, arzdarank zap, ani poilea soptakachi checklist.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.today: Aiz lok tumkam koxe sodtat ani koxe join zatat?
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.today.hint: Udaharonn: ami tankam call kortanv, te amchea app-acher register kortat, magir ami documents verify kortanv.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.dropoff: Lok khoim soddtat? (fokot akdde, nanvam naka)
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.dropoff.hint: Udaharonn: 40 jannank sompork kelo, 12 jannanim zap dilo, 3 jannanim sign-up puro kelo.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.week1: Novea monxak poilea soptakant kitem zai?
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.week1.hint: Udaharonn: konnak call korcho, eka senior sangata poilim visit, shift koxi choltat.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.try.label: Tumchea hiring pavlamnim suru korat
pkg.social-posts.title: Girayk haddtat osle post
pkg.social-posts.short: Tumchea xelint eka soptakache post ani caption, tumi svota kaddunk xoktat oslea photo idea sangata.
pkg.social-posts.problem: Post korunk zai tem tumkam kollit asa, punn dor dis kitem sangchem tacho vichar korunk vell na.
pkg.social-posts.outcome: Hea soptakachea post-ancho plan, caption, hashtag ani photo idea sangata. Puro version-ant ek sado ek-panacho plan-ui mellta.
pkg.social-posts.q.business: Tumcho dhondo khuinchea prokaracho, ani khoim?
pkg.social-posts.q.special.hint: Fokot khoreo gozali: tumchi sogllean bori vostu, tumchi kotha, tumcho view.
pkg.social-posts.q.week.hint: Udaharonn: menu-ant novi vostu, fest-achea disamni ugddpache vell, ek workshop.
pkg.social-posts.try.label: Hea soptakacho plan magat
_notes: DRAFT v1.0 (2026-10-19), Romi Konkani, for a Goan reviewer; nothing final. Conventions follow the v1.2 glossary: owners addressed as tumi (-at imperatives); buttons (btn.*) use short tu-imperatives to the page (kor, ugodd, rav), like the AI-addressed prompts. Glossary terms reused: helper, card, copy/paste korat, "Message yourself" (svotak message), draft, girayk, soptak, xeli, sucheo, bholaikechi mahiti, quick replies (beginche zap), dev borem korum. Kept in English on purpose: pkg.follow-ups.try.placeholder "sequence" and pkg.social-posts.try.placeholder "week" are the trigger words the English helpers wait for ("When I say 'sequence' / 'week'") and are sent as the message when the box is empty; translating them could stop the helper from starting. "go" placeholders became "suru kor" (no helper keys on "go"). "Customer 1" in the customer-replies placeholder kept because the helper uses that label. Reviewer check first: 1) draft.note and footer wording (anvad for 'translation'; 'Hem draft korta; tumi sogllem svota check korun dhaddtat'). 2) Words that may sound bookish or off in Goa: somosso (problem), dozanamni (dozens), vornnon (description), arzdar (applicant), akdde (numbers), kosob (gloss for Skills), xokti (gloss for Capabilities), code cholovp (code execution), ugddas (reminder), tokrari (complaints). 3) Possible ambiguity: social-posts 'your view' rendered as 'tumcho view' (scenery vs opinion is unclear in the English); staff-checklists placeholder 'bar, closing' rendered 'bar, bond korpachi shift'; 'Make my helper' as 'Mhojo helper kor' (vs 'tayar kor'). Also check soptak vs suman, and 'sogllo Goa' vs 'sogllo Goem'.
